methods: Frozen original PhysX seven-arm exact-source control; add one precisely defined eighth predeclared periodic (not adaptive) information readback baseline, no changes to original seven arms.
source_policy: unchanged third-party pretrained frozen PPO (no training)
controller: one Panda pd_ee_target_delta_pose source achieved-relative pd_ee_delta_pose
fault: actually dispatch arm-only zero/hold action at simulator step index 2, unknown receipt; gripper unchanged

precommitted_nonadaptive_query_placebo.name: fault_precommitted_seed_schedule_query
precommitted_nonadaptive_query_placebo.mechanism: At the FIRST post-fault decision (step index 3), query the actual privileged controller target EXACTLY ONCE if and ONLY IF seed modulo 4 equals 0; otherwise never query and follow precisely the original bounded no-readback/refusal policy. The schedule is fixed independently of state, fault result, observed geometry, task reward and outcomes.
precommitted_nonadaptive_query_placebo.fairness: approximately matched query budget to historical 15/64 adaptive reads; actual adaptive query count on new held-out episodes must be reported, not forced to 16; fixed protocol no post-hoc budget matching

required_per_seed_evidence: all 64 unique seeded native success flags across eight arms
real source policy competence and initial observation equality
all action projection/refusal and target-bound checks
original artifact hashes, stdout and environment
paired discordance selective vs precommitted schedule
scope_limitations: One native simulated Panda controller family; not cross-robot transfer
physically held arm target not real ROS/network packet loss
privileged controller target getter is additional information
commanded-target geometry bound is not achieved-motion or collision safety
seed modulo 4 schedule is a non-adaptive precommitted control, not genuinely random sampling
finite 64 task seed episodes insufficient alone to prove general statistical advantage
a user fork merge is NOT external upstream acceptance
